Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
Aren't there a lot of couples out today？ ...All over each other like that. It's embarrassing just watching.
If we did the same thing, it wouldn't be embarrassing, right？
Oh, great idea!
Eh？
It was a joke, obviously. Too bad for you.
Kobayakawa
A date in the park is a real classic, huh.
So classic it's boring？
Not really.
Then it's fine.
Going on a trip for a date is nice too, but I also like just aimlessly walking around together.
Kobayakawa
Still holding hands on a park date even when you're old and gray... That's really nice, isn't it.
Oh, those two？ I see them around a lot.
They live in my neighborhood, and they're always so close.
Then want to follow their lead？
That's not why I brought it up, but... for that couple's sake, I'll allow it.
Kobayakawa
Everyone plays hide-and-seek on the shrine grounds when they're a kid, don't they.
Maybe so. So you played hide-and-seek too, ▲小早川＊▲. You were surprisingly active.
Well, I was good at hiding. Even now, I'm confident an amateur could never find me.
Are there pros at hide-and-seek？
You're looking at one. I still hide from the teachers all the time, so my skills are well-honed.
(That's really nothing to be proud of...)
We're already here, so let's offer a prayer...
Kobayakawa
...Hey. What did you wish for？
That I can stay with you forever, ▲小早川＊▲.
Come on, I feel like I've heard that line somewhere before.
No need to try and get clever with this stuff. Simple is best. You like that too, right, ▲小早川＊▲？
...Hehe, that was a surprisingly solid comeback. Yeah, I don't hate it.
What do you think about getting matching charms？
Kobayakawa
I don't mind, but... there are so many kinds. Traffic safety, family safety, safe childbirth. Luck in love... guess we don't need that anymore.
True... In that case, maybe good health？
Hmm, that doesn't feel very high school.
If we're going for high school, then academics？
Hmm, that doesn't feel very me.
(Can't argue with that...)
You've been quiet for a while. Was it not very good？
Kobayakawa
...No, not at all. I was just thinking I didn't know movies could be that good.
Oh, you liked it that much, huh.
A lot of the time I lose focus before a movie's over, but not with that one.
Rare to hear rave reviews from you. You're usually such a harsh critic.
Well, yeah. Which means this movie's definitely going to be a hit.
Kobayakawa
That one was actually pretty good.
Well, it is one of the biggest releases of the season.
The story was a little shallow, but as a date movie, it's a pretty good choice, isn't it？
Haha, tough critic as always.
When you watch a movie in theaters, it's not just about quality. The occasion matters, too.
Kobayakawa
I know I shouldn't complain to you, but I want my time back after sitting through that.
Sorry...
I'm not trying to make you apologize. I just want us to trash it together.
Eh？
Otherwise I won't be able to let it go. If we tear it to shreds, we'll feel a little better, right？
Got it. Guess I'll join in, then.
Kobayakawa
I thought watching a romance movie with my boyfriend would be embarrassing, but...
How was it？
It's nice once in a while... maybe.
Haha, I'm glad. Actually, I started getting embarrassed halfway through, too.
I might be in a bit of a romantic mood right now. Emphasis on 'might,' though.
Kobayakawa
Mmm... That was great! That dive off the roof was really exciting, wasn't it？
Hard to believe that wasn't CGI.
And no stunt double, either. There's something really rock 'n' roll about that.
Sounds like you really liked it, then.
Yeah. I think it's a good movie for when you want to clear your head.
How was it？ What'd you think？
Kobayakawa
No comment.
Huh？ Was it boring？
I just said no comment, didn't I？
Yeah, but your face is twitching.
If I let my guard down, I'm gonna start laughing again thinking about it. Don't talk to me.
(Guess that means she liked it.)
Kobayakawa
So, is sci-fi one of those things guys romanticize, or what？
I don't think every guy's like that... Does that mean you didn't get it, ▲小早川＊▲？
I followed the main plot, but weren't there way too many pointless little details？
Yeah, it can definitely be like that.
I figured that stuff's what guys get so into. Well, the story was good, so that's fine by me.
How was it, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
It was interesting, but it wasn't scary.
Wonder what that says about it as a horror movie.
Does it matter, as long as it's good？ I think I would've enjoyed it even if it weren't a horror movie.
So the story itself was good, then.
Counting the visuals and direction, yeah. Horror fans might feel differently, though.
Was an anime movie an iffy choice for a date？
Kobayakawa
I think it's fine. I actually enjoyed it quite a bit.
That's surprising. I thought you'd say it was childish or something.
I watch kids' anime with my little brother, so maybe I'm just used to it.
Huh. That actually makes you sound pretty mature, in a way.
Hehe, think so？ Just looking at it from a step back, I guess.
Kobayakawa
You know how good bowlers make the ball curve way in halfway down the lane？
The one where it hooks right at the edge of the gutter？
Yeah. I kind of want to try doing something like that.
I think you should work on throwing it straight where you're aiming first...
Forget that, that's boring. I'm gonna practice it.
(She's probably just gonna throw a bunch of gutters... Well, as long as it's fun.)
Kobayakawa
There are quite a few families here, huh.
Why don't you bring your little brother sometime, ▲小早川＊▲？
It might still be too hard for him. Once he's a bit older, going with the whole family could be nice.
Hmm~.
What, got that nosy old man look on your face again？
Haha, something like that.
Kobayakawa
Ugh, my score isn't going up at all.
I think that's not a bad score for a girl, though.
"For a girl"？ That's sexist.
What, just for saying that？
Now I'm mad. I'm definitely gonna beat your score...
(I really fired up her competitive streak...)
Kobayakawa
Mmm, that was awesome!
It was worth coming out.
Well, they were still a bit rough around the edges, but they've got something good.
Haha, for you to say that much, ▲小早川＊▲, they must be pretty special, huh？
Better start bragging now that I had my eye on them from the start.
Nothing beats live music. Don't you think, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
I won't argue with that, but I wish there'd been a little more surprise to it.
Surprise？
Yeah. Maybe I'm asking too much, but I want something you can only get live.
Sounds tough to pull off.
It's no good if it feels forced, anyway. I guess it just comes down to luck.
(Satisfying ▲小早川＊▲ completely seems like a tall order...)
Kobayakawa
...Sigh. Sorry to say this after watching it together, but it wasn't very good.
Yeah...
They played well enough, but it felt like they were just going through the motions...
Man, you're a tough critic.
Once the audience starts compromising, culture is dead.
How was it？
Kobayakawa
Cheap, mass-produced music that sold its soul to commercialism.
Eh？
I thought that was the kind of answer you expected.
I actually thought it was pretty good, so that's a bit much...
I know, I'm kidding. I thought it was good too.
Kobayakawa
The closing band! They were really great, weren't they？
I thought so too. So you liked them, ▲小早川＊▲？
They just do their own thing. I like how they don't care what anyone thinks.
They looked pretty plain, but their sound left the biggest impression on me.
It had real grit and hit you right in the chest... Now that's real rock!
Kobayakawa
Hey. Do you actually get what makes jazz good？
When you put it like that... I just think it sounds nice, I guess.
Same here. I wish I could actually put it into words, though.
If it feels good to listen to, isn't that enough？
Maybe, but... I want to understand it properly.
Kobayakawa
...Hip-hop, huh. I really don't get what kids these days are into.
"Kids these days"？ ...Aren't you one of them, ▲小早川＊▲？
My soul belongs in '70s London.
That's a pretty big gap... So today was a bust for you, then.
...Actually, it wasn't bad to listen to. Even I'm surprised. Wonder why.
Kobayakawa
So you're into this kind of stuff too, huh.
Well... yeah, I guess.
Hmm. Well, I actually liked it quite a bit too.
You've got a cute voice too, ▲小早川＊▲, so why not？
I don't mind the compliment, but... I'm pretty sure it's not that simple a world.
Kobayakawa
Say... doesn't listening to someone talk in the dark make you sleepy？
Yeah, I kind of get what you mean.
It was a close call for me earlier, actually.
The story was interesting, so that kinda kept me anchored. I was drifting back and forth between sleep and reality.
That actually sounds kind of nice.
Did you ever watch stuff like this when you were little？
Kobayakawa
No, not really. I doubt I could've sat through it till the end.
Fair point... How was it now？
Yeah, it was pretty fun. Though parts of it were so surreal I had no idea what was going on.
Oh, you too, ▲小早川＊▲？ Here I thought you'd get that kind of thing.
What's that supposed to mean？ Are you calling me surreal？
Kobayakawa
Hehe. To tell the truth, I was really looking forward to karaoke today.
Oh, you're way more hyped than usual.
Of course I am. I heard they finally added the song I've been requesting.
I see. So today's its big debut, huh.
Yep, pretty much. Alright, let's put it in right away.
▲小早川＊▲, what do you want to drink？
Kobayakawa
Forget that, we need to queue up some songs first. We're wasting time.
Picking a drink barely takes any time...
Here, you're up first. I already put a song in for you. Good luck!
Huh？ Oh man, alright, fine.
Yeah!
Kobayakawa
Now then, next up is... yeah, let's go with this one.
Huh？ Wait, this song is...
It's a duet. Consider it a special treat from me today.
Haha... Makes me feel a little shy.
If you get all shy, you'll make me embarrassed too. No being shy allowed.
Kobayakawa
Oh... No looking at that gondola over there.
Huh, what？ ...Oh, they're kissing.
You don't have to say it out loud, geez.
I wonder if they don't mind people seeing them... Right？
Why are you asking me, geez？ Obviously I'd mind...
Oh, sorry. I stepped on your foot, didn't I？
Kobayakawa
It's fine. Ferris wheels are pretty cramped... Hehe.
？ Did I say something funny？
Nope. Being in here... close enough for our feet to touch like this is kinda nice.
Yeah, it is...
They say they revamped this haunted house to make it twice as scary, though...
Kobayakawa
There's a limit to what man-made things can do.
Even so, you could at least act a little more surprised.
Whether it's a ghost or whatever, if it gets in my way... Bam.
(Ghosts sure have it rough...)
That one was pretty scary. Even ▲小早川＊▲...
Kobayakawa
That was a foul. They're not scaring people, they're just startling them.
True. Anyone'd jump if something leaped out at them like that...
It's cheap. I think they should rethink the whole production from scratch.
(She must really hate that it scared her...)
...It's over. That one was rough...
Kobayakawa
Don't look so miserable. We're going on it again.
Huh!？ ...We're riding it again？
No whining! Come on, let's get back in line.
Ugh...
Aren't girls supposed to go "Eek, scary!" and cling to their boyfriends on these？
Kobayakawa
Hmm... So that's what you want to do.
Well, just speaking in general？
Then want me to give you a hug as a bonus？
Really!？
Oh, sorry. Today's not bonus day. Maybe next time.
(What the heck is bonus day？ )
Kobayakawa
...Ugh, it's so crowded I can't see the parade.
Want to ride on my shoulders？
I'm not a kid, geez.
Then let's go over to those steps.
...Look, can you see from here？
...Yeah, it's pretty... Hehe, it was worth coming to see after all.
▲小早川＊▲？ Are you sleepy by any chance？
Kobayakawa
Mm, just a little.
That's rare for you. Want to head home？
I'm fine. We came all this way to see the parade, so it'd be a waste.
True, but if you get sleepy, you can lean on my shoulder.
...Mhm, thanks.
▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
I called your name a few times, but you were totally entranced.
...Well, I am a girl, after all.
Haha, that's honest of you.
Well, at a time like this, at least... Just make sure you forget you saw me like this later.
Kobayakawa
Oh, that pretty girl over there is waving at you!
Eh！？
...How do you fall for something so obvious？
I didn't fall for it... That was just a reflex.
Ugh, making excuses is just pathetic.
(What was I supposed to do...？ )
Phew... Time for a little break.
Kobayakawa
I haven't had nearly enough fun yet. We've only gone down the water slide five times!
I think five times is plenty, though...
Geez... What am I gonna do with you, old man.
Oh my...
After a quick break, we're riding it at least five more times, okay？
(...Good grief.)
Kobayakawa
I feel like you've been sneaking glances at me for a while now... What is it？
It's nothing weird. Not like there's a rule against looking at you.
You've got a dirty look in your eyes.
I was born this way!
I see. So you were born a pervert...
(She's twisting my words...)
Kobayakawa
Even when you know it's just a projection, it feels strangely like being surrounded by stars.
...Yeah, it really does.
It makes me feel like I can forget all the little things and just be honest with myself.
Oh yeah？ Well then...
...Well then, what？ I'm sensing ulterior motives from you, so forget what I said about being honest.
(Whaaat！？)
Kobayakawa
A sky full of stars... It really is beautiful.
With all the city lights in real life, you rarely get to see this many stars.
Someday, I'd like to go somewhere far away and look at the stars like this... just the two of us.
So 'just the two of us' is the important part, huh.
Don't latch onto that part. Still, yeah, it is important. You know what I mean.
Kobayakawa
Hey, all the couples around us... They're all snuggled up together.
Well, it's that kind of atmosphere.
...That's not what I'm getting at.
Should we head out, then？
That's not it... Come on, take a hint already.
(This is hard...)
Kobayakawa
Taking care of this many plants must be hard work.
Especially since they all need different conditions.
Speaking of which, Tama hasn't been looking very lively at home lately.
Your cactus？
Yeah. Think the staff here would give me some advice？
Hmm, they might.
Kobayakawa
Some plants have scientific names that sound nothing like their Japanese names.
Like what...？
This is a tsubaki, but... um, it says here it's "Camellia japonica."
Huh. Maybe I'll call them that from now on, then. Camellia japonica!
No way, too much trouble. You can do that on your own.
Kobayakawa
Ugh, it's so muggy in here...
Well, it is set for the plants, after all.
Isn't there anywhere a bit more comfortable for humans？
I don't know... It is a botanical garden.
They need to think of the viewers, too. This place can't run on just the plants.
(Talk about unreasonable...)
Kobayakawa
It's nice coming to an event like this once in a while. I had a pretty good time.
I'm glad to hear that. Made the trip worth it.
I'm tired, sure, but it's a good kind of tired.
Think you could get hooked？
Not sure I like how you put it, but...yeah, I guess so. Wouldn't mind coming again.
So, how was the event today？
Kobayakawa
Hmm... Average, for better or worse.
Just average, huh...
If the organizers realize what needs improving, maybe next time will be better.
What needs improving, for example？
Setting the event aside... Little things like line control, admission, and announcements matter, too.
(She's surprisingly picky about the little things...)
▲小早川＊▲... Are you in a bad mood？
Kobayakawa
I can't believe the staff didn't direct the crowd when it was that packed.
Yeah... The management really was terrible.
That's a problem before the event even starts. There's no enjoying it like this.
And what about the event itself...？
Oh, that was terrible, too.
▲小早川＊▲, you looked pretty bored next to me. Were you all right？
Kobayakawa
Why is it that classical music always makes people so sleepy？
Maybe what makes you sleepy is...the rhythm, or something？
Still, I wasn't snoozing away like the person next to me, was I？
You had the seat on the end, right, ▲小早川＊▲？
Yep. Which means there was only one person sitting next to me.
...Sorry.
...Haha.
Kobayakawa
...What？
At first you were all 'An idol concert, really？', and now you liked it enough to buy merch.
So what？ It really moved me.
I'm not saying there's anything wrong with it.
Good. Idols are just like pro wrestling. There are a lot of phonies out there, but the real deal is incredible.
(Whoa, she's getting pretty passionate about this...)
Kobayakawa
With musicals, I can never really tell if they're supposed to be a concert or a play.
How was today's show？
...Yeah, I still couldn't really tell.
I see...
Oh, don't look so down. It's not like I was bored. I actually had fun, okay？
Really？ Well, as long as you enjoyed it.
Get too hung up on labels and you miss the whole point. What matters is whether you enjoy it.
Kobayakawa
Nothing gets the blood pumping like seeing a match live.
I know, right？
It's a different thrill from video games. You can hear them breathing and everything, and then... Wham!
...Ow. ...That packed more punch than usual.
Oh, sorry. Got carried away. That might've been a medium kick.
(Does she have a heavy kick, too...？)
Kobayakawa
...So, that last inning. That's what they call a walk-off win？
You know the basic rules of baseball, right？
More or less. Watching the cheering section was way more fun, though.
Haha, well, that's one way to enjoy the game.
Especially that mascot doing backflips! He's so creepy-cute♪
(Yeah, he really was creepy-cute...)
Kobayakawa
I don't... do well with crowds...
Everyone's so intense here, we don't stand a chance against them.
Yeah, it's definitely not somewhere you just drop by for sightseeing. I had fun, though, so it's fine.
I wonder if it gets even more fun once you're a regular？
Maybe, but... I think I'll pass. I've got too many hobbies keeping me busy as it is.
Kobayakawa
I heard a magazine listed the Bay Bridge as a 'hidden gem' of a date spot.
A hidden gem...？ I'm pretty sure it's super famous.
Right？ Whoever wrote that article must've been so embarrassed. Poor thing.
You're actually worried about the writer？
It just breaks my heart picturing people saying, 'Apparently they'd never even heard of the Bay Bridge.'
Kobayakawa
The view from here is really pretty, isn't it？ It looks like a postcard.
Um... 'No view could ever be as beautiful as you.'
Yeah, yeah, that doesn't suit you at all. Was that from last week's drama？
Haha, busted. I just kind of wanted to try saying a line like that.
I'd be happy just hearing how you really feel, instead of some borrowed line.
Being like this kind of puts you in a romantic mood, doesn't it？
Kobayakawa
Does it？ I was picturing a giant monster destroying the Bay Bridge.
Come on... We're a couple, so couldn't you at least...
Then want to try doing couple stuff？ Like leaning on your shoulder, or linking arms. You'd just get embarrassed anyway.
That goes for both of us.
Hehe, who knows.
Kobayakawa
So when you see your girlfriend in a swimsuit, does it make you fall for her all over again？
Well... I wonder.
Quit staring. That's not falling in love again, you're just being a dirty old man.
It's not like that. It's not something I get to see all the time... I have to burn this rare sight of my girlfriend into my memory.
I see... Hmm, I feel like you're just dressing it up in nice words, and it doesn't make it any less pervy.
(Ugh, she might be right...)
Kobayakawa
I always wonder... How do people get a figure like that？
Ah... Well, you don't need to, ▲小早川＊▲. You're fine just the way you are.
It helps to hear you say that. I don't feel like I could ever pull that off anyway.
Yeah.
It's a big help having a lolicon for a boyfriend.
That's not what I meant!
Kobayakawa
Geez, if you're my boyfriend, keep your eyes on me!
What's wrong？
You wandered off, so some guy tried to hit on me.
What!? Sorry, are you okay？ Where did the guy go...
Probably the hospital by now. I kicked him.
I keep telling you that's dangerous...
▲小早川＊▲. Isn't the water cold？
Kobayakawa
Not at all. It's just cool enough to feel nice.
Good grief... You can be kind of childish sometimes.
Did you say something, old man？
Nooope, nothing at all.
Come on, when you stand barefoot at the water's edge, it feels really nice when the waves pull back. Why don't you try it？
Alright, alright, I'll join you.
Kobayakawa
...Hehe.
What's up？ Did you find something？
Nope. It's just, when we're all alone somewhere quiet like this, don't you ever feel like maybe we're the only ones left in the world？
Yeah, I think I get that. What would you do if we really were the only two left in the world？
Wouldn't that be fine？ I'd hate to be alone, but if it's the two of us...
Kobayakawa
...Brr, it's freezing. We're idiots for coming to the beach this time of year.
I thought it'd feel nice with the air so clear, though.
I'd take warm air over clear air any day.
Yes, yes.
Or a warm boyfriend. ...Come here.
...Yeah.
Kobayakawa
I wonder what's going through this guy's head.
Hmm, maybe he's just stunned, zoning out like a fish.
Stunned, like a fish... And for short？
Sunfish.
I can't dock you points for that pun... so is a kick okay instead？
No good！！
▲小早川＊▲？ Why are you glaring at the tank？
Kobayakawa
He picked a fight, so I'm taking him on. He glared at me first.
A staring contest with a sunfish？ Can anyone even win that？
I can't read his face... yet it feels like he sees right through me. He's a tricky opponent.
(When did he become the enemy...？)
Kobayakawa
Hey, do you think you can keep a penguin as a pet？
Recreating an environment like this at home would be rough. Do you want one？
As if. I was just asking.
Yeah, figured... I wonder if you have to walk a penguin, though.
With a collar and a leash？ That'd look pretty surreal.
Kobayakawa
Penguins really are charming little creatures, aren't they？
Yeah, like how they waddle around.
Being born that cute basically makes them winners at life.
Haha, do you like them almost as much as cats now？
Not a chance. Cats are in a different league. They're in the Hall of Fame.
(Figured as much.)
Whoa... awesome! A school of sardines is seriously impressive.
Kobayakawa
Only grade-schoolers get a pass for yelling like that. Act your age, you're embarrassing me.
Haha, my bad!
Oh! Hey, look, look! There's a manta ray swimming by!
Grade-schooler...
Shut up, it's fine! It's a manta ray, after all.
(I have no idea what difference that makes!)
Kobayakawa
I wonder who invented the underwater tunnel.
Turning a fish tank into a tunnel is pretty clever, yeah.
Pretty sure they turned a tunnel into a fish tank.
Huh...？ Which one is it？
Doesn't really matter which. So let's just say they turned a tunnel into a fish tank.
Kobayakawa
You can't go to an aquarium and skip the dolphin show.
Yeah, it's the main attraction.
Some places let you swim with the dolphins, right？ I wonder if they don't do that here.
Never heard of them doing it here...
Wonder what it'd take. Maybe I should become a shareholder here？
(I can't tell if she's being a dreamer or a realist here...)
▲小早川＊▲, if you go too far up front, you'll get splashed.
Kobayakawa
Getting splashed a little is part of the fun of a dolphin show.
Alright, then me too!
Whoa！ ？
Geez, look at you.
When did you get out of the way, ▲小早川＊▲？
Hehe, you can thank fighting games for honing my dodging reflexes.
(Seriously...？)
Kobayakawa
This park is pretty popular with couples, isn't it？
Yeah... Apparently there's even more of them late at night for some reason.
Wow...
Not that it has anything to do with high schoolers, though.
Hmm, look at you being all wholesome for once.
Hey, I'm always wholesome.
Kobayakawa
I think I actually kind of like the view of the ocean from this park.
Yeah. Sometimes you can even see cruise ships leaving the port.
Now if only this place would tone it down a little.
Really？ It's pretty quiet, though.
Not the noise, the vibe. It just screams "date spot," you know？
(Well, we're on a date here too...)
Kobayakawa
It's a little breezy today, huh？
Yeah... Makes it feel like a real seaside park, though.
True, and it doesn't smell like low tide or anything. It's actually pretty nice.
We've got the sea and the breeze, so all that's left is...
Lightning, maybe？ You know, to spice things up.
(Pretty sure that'd ruin the nice weather real quick...)
Kobayakawa
When you look down like this, doesn't it feel like you're gonna get sucked in？
Oh, wait. Are you afraid of heights or something？
No way... I just have an active imagination, that's all. Like, I can vividly picture getting sucked in...
You definitely have an active imagination, yeah. Or is it more like... delusions？
(That's uncalled for... probably.)
Kobayakawa
For a place that gets this many couples, the souvenirs here are pretty weak, huh？
Yeah... It's all Sky Tower rice crackers and Sky Tower bean wafers.
They should make a transforming Sky Tower robot or something. My little brother would love that.
Well sure, kids would love it, but...
Better yet, make the actual tower transform and turn it into a ride! How about that？
Haha, now that actually sounds fun.
Kobayakawa
When you're inside a building like this, don't you ever wonder how you'd escape in an emergency？
I kinda get it, but... isn't that less cautious and more just pessimistic？
You think？ I think it's a pretty fun thing to daydream about.
Daydream？ We're talking about escape devices, right？
Like sliding down a chute to escape, or getting launched out in a one-person mini rocket. Stuff like that.
(Is this another thing she picked up from watching robot anime with her little brother？)
Kobayakawa
I'm gonna go try this on, so wait here a sec. Let me know what you think.
Sure, leave it to me.
Hm, what's wrong？
...That just sounded like such a cliché couple exchange, I'm not sure I can let it slide...
Come on, what's wrong with cliché as long as we're having fun？
Kobayakawa
The world's supposed to be so convenient now, so why is it still such a pain to find clothes just because your measurements are a little off average？
Is it really like that？ Though I guess girls do have it tougher.
Seriously. Girls' bodies have a lot more... how do I put it, variety to them.
Variety？ What do you mean？
You know... curves in some places, not in others, stuff like that!
(Better not press her any further on this...)
